'''Shass ''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Corporal/Legends|corporal]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Stationed on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], Shass managed a small shop, where he also taught the knowledge of [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]] construction to others.
